title: Action Roll
hook: Roll when a PC does something uncertain and consequences matter.

blocks.label: What It Is
blocks.body: Roll when a PC does something uncertain and consequences matter.

blocks.label: How It Works
blocks.body: When a PC tries something uncertain and meaningful, choose a trait, set Difficulty, roll Hope d12 + Fear d12, add bonuses, compare total, then read Hope/Fear spin.

blocks.label: Try It
blocks.body: Give a player Presence 12 to calm a worried animal, then ask what Hope or Fear changes in the scene.

affordances: Player states the action in the fiction.
GM names the trait that best matches the method and the Difficulty.
Player rolls Hope d12 + Fear d12 and adds trait, Experience, or advantage/disadvantage.
Compare total to Difficulty, then resolve the Hope/Fear or critical result.
